coverage.note: This audit revalidates recorded coverage; it is not a new full reread. Supporting runtime excerpts do not add whole-file coverage.

citation_audit.note: Range validity does not independently prove each claim; findings retain source reasoning and probe limits.

within_unit_grouping.disposition: Different consumers lose different parts of the target: remote repository, applied PR, diff endpoints, dirty changes, metadata SHA, mutation checkout, qualified repository, link revision or PR base. A common target descriptor may fix several; raw observations remain traceable.
Version agreement, executable identity, publication repository and completion receipt are distinct checks.
Verification commands, diagram prescription, HTML issue conversion and atomic execution boundaries are separate contradictions.
Persisted parent summary, automatic media upload and peer read-exposure rationale concern distinct data paths.
Port selection, selected Procfile and server identity remain independently falsifiable.
Shared ownership, terminal publication, retrieval completeness, actor identity, resolution proof and persisted retries are separate lifecycle failures.
Runner-up commit existence, crash reconciliation and batch budget admission need different guards.
Metric routing, calibration inference and preference persistence are distinct.
Cap precedence, scheduler arithmetic and binding count are separate stale facts; cross-claim consolidation remains necessary.
Structured choices, merged readiness and dismissed-action correlation have different runtime contracts.
Each contradicts a different owning workflow; do not count the generic theme itself as an additional defect.

Session eligibility, absence inference, review stage order, pagination, historical grounding, residual labels, recurrence inference, release availability and resume freshness are different evidence losses.
Retain separate observations with their own cited trigger and corrective action; broad duplication and complexity themes belong in synthesis, not additional raw findings.
